title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You're after my help? Hehe, if you're nice enough to offer up three days of premium feed for my little buddies, I might just think about it! How's that sound? Pretty sweet deal, huh…? Hey, wait—I'm just kidding! Don't go!

title: Talk 1
original: Outta the way, outta the way! Beanstalk Breeding Center's out for a walk. Mind y'all's step, no trampling the little ones.

title: Talk 2
original: Holy moly! Click's here at Rhodes Island? Doctor, why didn't you tell me! I'm a huge fan of her outdoorsy videos! She's even talked about how cute Pea is and brought up taking Pea along for her next shoot!

title: Talk 3
original: It's everyone yapping about going mining. I might could forget their digging random holes all over the wilderness like total idiots, but messing up our living space? If I catch those numbskulls AGAIN—see my crossbow? My bolts'll put new holes in their asses!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, I done finished my breeding proposal. Take a look, will ya? Huh? The budget doesn't add up...? Ugh, busted. Ohhh, my mistake! Probably got the numbers mixed up somewhere! I'll get it fixed right away.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Before coming to Rhodes Island, I sent out lots of resumes to different companies, but there weren't no takers. Now look at my little buddies, Doc, they're all-rounders—they can fight, haul, and everything in between! Those bosses just wouldn't know talent if it bit 'em on the behind. Their loss!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Pea here is the smallest and sharpest of my Metal Crabs. Definitely gonna be something special! Unlike those ordinary ones, my little buddies are super clever. No way they'd let just anyone push them around!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: One-two! One-two! Line up! Defense position, and block! Good job, fellers! Y'all come get a treat now! Alright, let's switch to attack—Mercy me! Doctor, how long've you been here? How come you walk so quiet?!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My pa never liked me raising these little ones, keeps saying they're worthless, how burdenbeasts rake in the real cash. Hmph, I'll make a name for me and my little buddies, we'll prove him wrong! Say, Doctor, might wanna throw some money my way? Profit guaranteed!

title: Idle
original: Hey, you with me, Doctor? Stay focused at work. Be a good kid like Pea, won'tcha?

title: Onboard
original: Howdy, Doctor. Name's Beanstalk. Starting today, I'm signin'... Eh? What's in my carrier? Oh, this here's my little buddy, Peacake. C'mon, Pea, say hi to the Doctor.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Well, I'll be! That's awesome! You see that, Pea? Watch and learn some!

title: Promotion 1
original: Ehe, we're getting promoted because of how well we did in the last operation, ain't that right?

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, thanks for giving me and my little buddies a chance to prove ourselves! Let's skip the fancy talk. Pea and the gang are gonna turn out even more awesome! You just wait and see!

title: Added to Squad
original: Let's show 'em what we're made of.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Alright, y'all! Follow my lead!

title: Depart
original: Team Beanstalk, move out!

title: Begin Operation
original: Huh? Is this what we're up against?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Here I am.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: All ready to go.

title: Deployment 1
original: Go! Show them what we've got!

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's go!

title: In Battle 1
original: Hehe, you can't hit me.

title: In Battle 2
original: Block'em!

title: In Battle 3
original: I won't let you get past us!

title: In Battle 4
original: You bastards! I won't let you hurt my buddies!

title: 4-star Result
original: Hehe, y'all ain't no match for us!

title: 3-star Result
original: Mission complete! How's that? My buddies did great, huh?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Oh, some of them got through! Wait here, Doctor. I'll go after them!

title: Operation Failure
original: It's okay, y'all. Don't cry. I'll give those jerks what for next time!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I can sleep anywhere. Where's the breedin' room, though?

title: Tap
original: Why'd you pull my ribbon? Stop it!

title: Trust Tap
original: Hm? What's up? Wanna pet Pea?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor! My New Year's wish is to get the Beanstalk Breeding Company up and running this year! If you might could just lend me a tiny bit of help, I promise I'll work twice as hard!

title: Greeting
original: Hey, what's up, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, Happy Birthday! Considering our special friendship, I've got a rare gift for you. Ta-da—a top-quality, healthy Metal Crab hatchling from the Beanstalk Breeding Company! Ain't it just adorable? Shh! Keep this between us, or everyone's gonna be begging me for one!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island parties are always a riot! But when are we gonna have a pet fair? We could decide once and for all whose pets are more capable, or just crown the most popular. Pet fights? Doctor! That's way too brutal!
